title: A Weekend Repair Workshop
instructions: Listen carefully. Choose the option that best matches what is said or implied.

audio.description: Two neighbours coordinate a small repair event.

transcript.text: Rain is forecast for Saturday. Should we move the repair tables indoors?
The hall is booked until noon. We could start outside later. I can bring covers, but they will not help in strong wind.
That works. I will tell everyone the new time and ask them to bring small items only.

questions.prompt: What might disrupt the original plan?
options: The hall being closed all day
questions.explanation: The organiser mentions a forecast of morning rain.

questions.prompt: Why can they not use the hall immediately?
options: It is too small for repair tables.
It is being cleaned after lunch.
questions.explanation: The neighbour says the hall is booked until noon.

questions.prompt: What will the organiser tell participants?
options: That the event will start later
questions.explanation: The organiser agrees to tell people about the later start and limit items to small ones.
